Leo · Listen & Shadow 24

What Everyone Gets Wrong — what people think, what you do, the myths
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · WHAT PEOPLE THINK YOU DO
👤 Brian
When someone asks what you do, what do you say?
누가 무슨 일 하냐고 물으면 뭐라고 해?
what you do — 무슨 일을 하는지
💬 Leo
I usually just say I'm a server developer.
보통 그냥 서버 개발자라고 해.
server developer — 서버 개발자 ('say a server developer'는 틀림 — I'm이 필요)
같은 패턴으로 — I usually just say I'm in IT. · I usually just say I work at a webtoon company.
💬 Leo
When you use an app, I build the system running behind it.
앱을 쓸 때 뒤에서 돌아가는 시스템을 만드는 거야.
run behind — 뒤에서 돌아가다
같은 패턴으로 — When you order online, I build what processes it. · When you tap pay, I build what happens next.
💬 Leo
Everything that happens behind the screen when you tap — that's what I build.
화면을 누르면 뒤에서 벌어지는 모든 게 내가 만든 거야.
behind the screen — 화면 뒤에서 · tap — 누르다
같은 패턴으로 — Everything after you press send — that's my part. · Everything the user doesn't see — that's us.
💬 Leo
They picture me as a hacker.
사람들은 나를 해커처럼 상상해.
picture ~ as ~ — ~를 ~로 상상하다 ('like a hacker'보다 'as a hacker'가 맞음)
같은 패턴으로 — They picture me as a guy in a hoodie. · People picture designers as artists.
💬 Leo
I've given up explaining that I don't fix laptops.
노트북 고쳐달라는 부탁은 설명을 포기했어.
give up ~ing — ~를 포기하다
같은 패턴으로 — I've given up explaining what a server is. · I've given up correcting them.
PART 2 · WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO
👤 Brian
How much of your week is actually writing code?
일주일 중에 실제로 코드 쓰는 건 얼마나 돼?
actually — 실제로
💬 Leo
Actually, most of it is managing and directing Claude instead of writing code — so about zero percent.
사실 대부분은 코드를 쓰는 게 아니라 Claude를 관리하고 지시하는 거야 — 거의 0%지.
direct — 지시하다 · instead of — ~ 대신
같은 패턴으로 — Actually, most of it is reviewing, not writing. · Most of it is deciding what to build, not building.
💬 Leo
The rest goes into reviews and meetings.
나머지는 검토랑 회의에 들어가.
go into ~ — ~에 들어가다
같은 패턴으로 — The rest goes into planning. · The rest goes into fixing what Claude got wrong.
💬 Leo
The part nobody sees is that we build flexible systems, not just features.
아무도 안 보는 부분은, 우리가 기능 하나가 아니라 유연한 시스템을 만든다는 거야.
flexible — 유연한 · feature — 기능
같은 패턴으로 — The part nobody sees is the testing. · The part nobody sees is how much gets thrown away.
💬 Leo
Honestly, I can't think of anything that would surprise my friends.
솔직히 친구들이 놀랄 만한 건 딱히 없어.
can't think of ~ — ~가 떠오르지 않다 ('I do not recognize anything it would surprise'는 틀린 문장)
같은 패턴으로 — I can't think of anything that would surprise you. · I can't think of a single boring day.
💬 Leo
My childhood friends all say my job is easy — just working with Claude.
어릴 때 친구들은 다 내 일이 쉽다고 해 — 그냥 Claude랑 일하는 거라고.
childhood friends — 어릴 때 친구들
같은 패턴으로 — My friends all say my job is just talking to AI. · My parents say my job is sitting.
💬 Leo
If I showed them my LLM system, they'd find it interesting — and still think my job is easy.
내 LLM 시스템을 보여주면 재밌어하겠지만, 그래도 쉽다고 할 거야.
find ~ interesting — ~를 흥미로워하다 · still — 그래도
같은 패턴으로 — If I showed them the code, they'd be impressed — and still not get it. · If I explained it, they'd nod and still think it's easy.
💬 Leo
It's less coding and more coordinating.
코딩보다는 조율에 가까워.
less ~ and more ~ — ~보다는 ~에 가까운 · coordinate — 조율하다
같은 패턴으로 — It's less typing and more thinking. · It's less building and more deciding.
PART 3 · THE MYTHS
👤 Brian
“AI will replace you” — what do you say to that?
"AI가 널 대체할 거야" — 뭐라고 할 거야?
replace — 대체하다
💬 Leo
If I could tell them one thing, it'd be this: even if Claude writes good code, a developer still has other work to do.
하나만 말할 수 있다면 이거야 — Claude가 좋은 코드를 써도 개발자는 할 일이 남아.
still has ~ to do — 할 ~가 남아 있다 ('developer will still have other job'은 관사·수 오류)
같은 패턴으로 — If I could tell them one thing, it'd be that the code is the easy part. · Even if the tool is good, someone has to decide what to build.
💬 Leo
That one's half true — the typing part is already gone.
그건 반은 맞아 — 코드를 쓰는 부분은 대체됐어.
half true — 반은 맞는
같은 패턴으로 — That one's half true — the easy part is automated. · Half true — it replaced the boring half.
💬 Leo
What people miss is that someone still has to decide what to build.
사람들이 놓치는 건, 뭘 만들지 정하는 건 여전히 사람이라는 거야.
what people miss is ~ — 사람들이 놓치는 건 ~
같은 패턴으로 — What people miss is the judgment. · What people miss is that Claude doesn't know the business.
💬 Leo
Honestly, you don't need much math.
솔직히 수학은 별로 필요 없어.
you don't need ~ — ~는 필요 없다
같은 패턴으로 — Honestly, you don't need a CS degree. · Honestly, you don't need to be antisocial.
💬 Leo
It's not that we're antisocial — it's that we need quiet to focus.
내성적이라서가 아니라, 집중할 때 조용한 게 필요한 거야.
it's not that ~, it's that ~ — ~가 아니라 ~다
같은 패턴으로 — It's not that I hate meetings — it's that they break the flow. · It's not the hours, it's the interruptions.
느리게 20/20 · 보통 20/20
